themes_detail.label: Street Signs Deteriorating
themes_detail.summary: Street sign damage complaints spiked to 4 this week vs. 1.4 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 191% increase—suggesting either infrastructure decay or acute vandalism requiring immediate public safety review in East Harlem.
evidence: 4 street sign damage complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.4 weekly baseline (z-score: 3.77, 191% spike)
Aligns with chronic community board budget request for street light repairs and DOT infrastructure investment
Single-week spike suggests acute incident or emerging systemic issue
reporting_angles: Walk East Harlem streets to photograph damaged signs and document safety implications for pedestrians and drivers
Interview DOT about response times and maintenance protocols in District 111

themes_detail.label: Litter Basket Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Residents filed 5 litter basket shortage complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.0 weekly average—a 400% spike (z-score: 3.27)—suggesting East Harlem neighborhoods are overwhelmed by inadequate waste infrastructure.
evidence: 5 litter basket requests THIS WEEK vs. 1.0 weekly average (z-score: 3.27, 400% spike)
Converges with chronic community board budget request for graffiti removal and sanitation investment
Suggests grassroots resident frustration with street cleanliness in past 7 days
reporting_angles: Document which blocks lack baskets; map coverage gaps against foot traffic patterns
Interview Sanitation Department on budget constraints and coverage strategy in East Harlem

themes_detail.label: Unleashed Dogs Surge
themes_detail.summary: Unleashed dog complaints jumped to 4 two weeks ago vs. 0.5 weekly average—a 700% spike (z-score: 4.95, highest severity)—indicating a potential public safety concern or enforcement gap in East Harlem parks and streets.
evidence: 4 unleashed dog complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.5 weekly baseline (z-score: 4.95, 700% spike—highest severity score)
Suggests either acute incident cluster or deteriorating leash law enforcement
Aligns with community board budget request for additional traffic enforcement agents
reporting_angles: Interview Parks Department and NYPD about leash law enforcement presence in East Harlem
Talk to residents near Marcus Garvey Park about recent dog incidents and safety concerns

themes_detail.label: Water System Failures
themes_detail.summary: Water system complaints peaked at 24 three weeks ago vs. 8.2 weekly average—a 191% spike (z-score: 4.3)—reflecting infrastructure strain that may signal DEP maintenance backlog in East Harlem.
evidence: 24 water system complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 8.2 weekly baseline (z-score: 4.3, 191% spike)
Converges with chronic community board budget request for DEP capital funding
Aligns with City Limits coverage of NYCHA elevator/building system repair delays in East Harlem
reporting_angles: Investigate DEP maintenance schedules and backlog status for East Harlem water infrastructure
Interview NYCHA residents about water outages and service disruptions in recent weeks

themes_detail.label: Illegal Dumping & Unsanitary Conditions
themes_detail.summary: Illegal dumping complaints hit 10 three weeks ago vs. 2.6 weekly average (281% spike, z-score: 3.48), paired with unsanitary animal complaints up 220% last week, suggesting environmental health deterioration in East Harlem.
evidence: 10 illegal dumping complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 2.6 weekly baseline (z-score: 3.48, 281% spike)
4 unsanitary animal complaints last week vs. 1.2 weekly baseline (z-score: 3.32, 220% spike)
710 unsanitary condition complaints over 90 days—second-highest category after residential noise
Community board repeatedly requests graffiti removal and environmental health funding
reporting_angles: Map illegal dumping hotspots; investigate whether enforcement presence increased or decreased
Document health code violations and animal control response times in affected areas
